QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_12

question.text: The Risk Reduction Mode is triggered when a clearing member's margin utilization reaches:

answer.text: 90% of the stock broker's/clearing member's collateral available for adjustment against margins

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 178 specifies that risk-reduction mode applies when 90% of the stock broker's/clearing member's collateral available for adjustment against margins is utilised. The Trap: The 90% threshold is at the clearing member's collateral-utilisation level, not at the client-collateral level; client-collateral monitoring is a separate TM/CM procedure described on page 179. Note: In risk-reduction mode, position-increasing orders are restricted and order behaviour is tightened until utilisation falls below the exit threshold.
